# Java Edition protocol/Object data

> Minecraft Java snapshot: `1.21.8`  
> Protocol version: `772`  
> Source: [Java Edition protocol/Object data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Object_data?oldid=2963034)  
> Revision: `2963034` (`2025-05-01T21:36:17Z`)  
> Retrieved: `2026-08-04T16:00:27+00:00`  
> License: [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)

This article documents the **Data** field in the [Spawn Entity](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Packets#Spawn_Entity "Java Edition protocol/Packets") packet. The field is of type Int, and the meaning of its contents depend on the [type of entity](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Entity_metadata "Java Edition protocol/Entity metadata") being spawned, as defined in the Type field of the same packet, and is documented below.

## Contents

- [1 Item Frame](https://minecraft.wiki#Item_Frame)
- [2 Painting](https://minecraft.wiki#Painting)
- [3 Falling Block](https://minecraft.wiki#Falling_Block)
- [4 Fishing Hook](https://minecraft.wiki#Fishing_Hook)
- [5 Projectile](https://minecraft.wiki#Projectile)
- [6 Warden](https://minecraft.wiki#Warden)

## [Item Frame](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Entity_metadata#Item_Frame "Java Edition protocol/Entity metadata")

| Value | Orientation |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Down |
| 1 | Up |
| 2 | North |
| 3 | South |
| 4 | West |
| 5 | East |

The Notchian client clamps invalid values into the valid range through the modulus operator. If the resulting value is negative, the absolute value is used.

Velocity in the packet is always ignored.

## [Painting](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Entity_metadata#Painting "Java Edition protocol/Entity metadata")

| Value | Orientation |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | North |
| 3 | South |
| 4 | West |
| 5 | East |

The Notchian client clamps invalid values into the valid range through the modulus operator. If the resulting value is negative, the absolute value is used.

[![](https://minecraft.wiki/images/thumb/Ambox_warning_pn.png/32px-Ambox_warning_pn.png?b6e1c)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Ambox_warning_pn.png "File:Ambox warning pn.png")

Although the values of 0 and 1 are invalid, the Notchian client uses the same clamping algorithm as [Item Frame](https://minecraft.wiki#Item_Frame), which can result in any value from 0 to 5. If the resulting value is invalid, the entity will fail to spawn.

Velocity in the packet is always ignored.

## [Falling Block](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Entity_metadata#Falling_Block "Java Edition protocol/Entity metadata")

| Field name | Field type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Block state ID | [Int](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Int "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | ID of the block state that the falling block will represent. |

Velocity in the packet is always ignored.

## [Fishing Hook](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Entity_metadata#Fishing_Hook "Java Edition protocol/Entity metadata")

| Field name | Field type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Owner | [Int](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Int "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | The entity ID of the owner |

[![](https://minecraft.wiki/images/thumb/Ambox_warning_pn.png/32px-Ambox_warning_pn.png?b6e1c)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Ambox_warning_pn.png "File:Ambox warning pn.png")

If the entity with the Owner ID doesn't exist in the client, the entity will fail to spawn.

Velocity in the packet is ignored, and instead should be inferred from the shooter's position.

[![](https://minecraft.wiki/images/Information_icon.svg?15c1c)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Information_icon.svg "File:Information icon.svg")

## [Warden](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Entity_metadata#Warden "Java Edition protocol/Entity metadata")

| Field name | Field type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pose | [Int](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Int "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | If a value of 1 is specified, the Warden will spawn in the [emerging pose](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Entity_metadata#Entity_Metadata_Format "Java Edition protocol/Entity metadata"). Any other value is silently ignored. |
